_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With zero of 72 windows producing a ±2+ move and no visible breaker yet, HOLD with high conviction is the statistically honest call — a directional guess here is exactly how the record went 0-for-18.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both identify the coil and the August 2024 analog, but split on implied urgency: narrative leans toward impending snap while analyst demands explicit confirmation signals before any directional commitment.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fed_liquidity rises above 20 + btc_exchange_reserves_pct_30d drops below 90 + funding compresses to 35-40 range
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 80 + btc_momentum_30d drops below 35 + mvrv_zscore falls below 15 (would push to Panic/Denial zone, breaking the analog)
